dataset.name: XM3600 (Crossmodal-3600, Thapliyal et al., EMNLP 2022) + Open Images V7 human-verified image labels (Kuznetsova et al., IJCV 2020)

refs1_randk.description: expected 1-reference gold size averaged across each image's 2-3 Vietnamese references

refs_all.description: union of all 2-3 Vietnamese references per image

oiv7_verified.description: Open Images V7 human-verified positive labels on the 82 mapped Vietnamese lexicon classes

refs_all.predicted_slope_sign: positive under transferred b (slope(refs_all) > 0); risky test since H3 showed b can compress on verbose outputs

oiv7_verified.predicted_slope_sign: positive (slope(OIV7) > 0, where F1 = 2 * verified_precision * pos_recall / (verified_precision + pos_recall))

relative_form_predictions.P4_mstar_mixed_sign_agreement: for each gold variant g in {refs1_firstk, refs1_randk, refs_all, oiv7_verified}, sign(slope_g) == sign(M*_mixed(g) - median_M)

kill_rule.h6_p2_kill: If >= 2 of the 3 out-of-sample sign predictions (refs1 < 0, refs_all > 0, OIV7 > 0) fail, N1 is demoted from core result to explanatory lemma / diagnostic.
kill_rule.h3_p2_r11_stop_rule: If slope(refs1_randk) >= 0 on XM3600, N1's 1-reference half fails in a third setting and the sign-flip claim is dropped entirely.

two_caption_panels_vi_vs_en.gold_I_panel: XM3600-en references on the exact same 600 images (data/datasets/xm3600_en/test_data.json, mapped via the 82-class / COCO-80 bilingual concept table)
two_caption_panels_vi_vs_en.prediction_kappa: Across count-matched contrasts (MCP / frontier residual d_rho) for zeroshot, p1_s43, and fuse2_s42, the transfer slope kappa(A -> I_panel) < 1 with 95% bootstrap CI upper bound < 1.
two_caption_panels_vi_vs_en.kill_rule: If the 95% CI of kappa(A -> I_panel) includes 1, partial transfer between caption panels is reported as KTVIC-specific.

refs_vs_oiv7_verified_labels.gold_A: XM3600-vi references (P, R, F1 via xm3600_oiv7.py score)
refs_vs_oiv7_verified_labels.gold_I_truth: OIV7 human-verified labels (verified_precision, neg_hallucination, pos_recall via xm3600_oiv7.py score)
predictions: C3-OIV7-1: KTVIC SFT adapters (p1_s43-short, fuse2_s42-short) achieve higher reference precision P than zeroshot-short on XM3600-vi refs, but their verified_precision gain on OIV7 over zeroshot-short is smaller than their reference precision gain (d_verified_precision < d_P_refs).

C3-OIV7-2: Detailed decoding (zeroshot-detailed, fuse2_s42-detailed) increases OIV7 pos_recall over short decoding (d_pos_recall > 0 with 95% CI > 0) while reducing XM3600-vi reference precision P (d_P_refs < 0).
C3-OIV7-3: Reference-false mapped mentions (ref_false_mapped) for p1_s43-short and fuse2_s42-short have a higher OIV7 present/(present+absent) share than zeroshot-detailed.
